description: Company Overview: GoodScore is on a mission to make financial literacy and credit access simple, actionable, and inclusive for over 150 million Indians who are credit-underserved. From starting personalized credit consulting in 2023 to now empowering over 1 million users to take control of their credit health, we are one of India’s fastest-growing credit score & credit management apps. We are backed by top VC funds in India, ranked among the top 10 finance apps in India, and are on the 1x to 100x journey. We’re building a team that shares our vision of transforming how India manages credit. Goodscore Raises Series A Role Description: We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Product Analyst to join our team in Bangalore. This is a unique opportunity to work directly with the founder and play a key role in driving our business forward through data-driven insights. If you are a first-principles problem solver, curious about uncovering the stories hidden within data, and constantly questioning the status quo, you will fit right in with us. Responsibilities: - Problem Identification: Collaborate closely with business and product teams to understand and translate business problems into analytical problem statements. - Insight Generation: Own the entire insight generation phase from problem identification to thorough analysis. - Data-Driven Decision Making: Present insights and recommendations based on data-driven hypotheses. - Analytics and Visualization: Act as the subject matter expert in analytics and visualization for the team. Design and build dashboards that are easy for the team to consume and utilize for data-driven decisions. - Collaboration and Communication: Interact with some of the industry's smartest professionals and get exposure to all facets of building a product at scale. Requirements: - Education: B. Tech degree from a tier-1 engineering college. - Experience: 1-3 years of experience in a similar role in a B2C company. - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. - Penchant for business and curiosity to understand how the product works. - Ability to write complex queries on SQL to manipulate and consolidate multiple data sources for dashboarding and analysis. - Intuition of data and ability to handle big data sources. - Strong working knowledge of Excel and visualization tools like PowerBI, Tableau, and QlikView. - Understanding of data-analysis languages such as R or Python and core statistical concepts. - Experience in building ML models is a plus, but not mandatory.

description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The opportunity The Product Manager – Event Experience role at EY represents an opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly expanding global events ecosystem. Using solutions from market-leading suppliers including Cvent, SpotMe, and related attendee-facing capabilities, this role leads a high-impact product cluster that supports registration, event websites, event apps, communications, accessibility, engagement, personalisation and post-event insight across EY’s global event programme. As EY scales its event technology footprint, this role must balance global standardisation with the nuance required by regional teams, audience expectations, strategic event goals and in-person, virtual and hybrid formats. The Event Experience portfolio is foundational to how attendees discover, register for, join, navigate, engage with and gain value from EY events worldwide. It is a highly visible position that helps deliver seamless, branded, inclusive and intuitive attendee journeys while improving adoption, engagement data, quality of experience and return on event technology investment. By driving product strategy, configuration standards, roadmap delivery, stakeholder alignment and enablement, the role strengthens EY’s ability to deliver cohesive, scalable and insight-rich event experiences globally. This role partners closely with event operations, Brand Marketing and Communications (BMC), Talent/Learning, regional build-and-run teams, producers, managed services, digital teams, suppliers and integration partners to ensure attendee-facing platforms are well-governed, effectively configured and continuously improved. The focus is on creating connected experiences across the full attendee journey, from nomination and registration through pre-event communications, agenda access, mobile and web experiences, networking, translation, engagement, onsite interactions, feedback and post-event analytics. Your Key Responsibilities Own the product vision and roadmap for EY’s Event Experience product cluster, with a focus on Cvent, SpotMe, and others with related capabilities that support attendee management, event apps, communications, engagement, accessibility and data capture. Design and improve end-to-end attendee journeys by defining product requirements, experience standards and configuration approaches that make EY events intuitive, branded, inclusive and easy to navigate across in-person, virtual and hybrid formats. Lead the evaluation, governance and deployment of attendee-facing AI capabilities, including attendee assistants, personalised agenda and content recommendations, intelligent networking, next-best-action prompts, translation, accessibility support and post-event insight generation. Partner with strategic events, BMC, Talent/Learning, regional teams, producers and managed service partners to capture demand, prioritise the backlog, and translate requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and rollout plans that improve the attendee experience while supporting operational delivery. Run discovery, pilots and controlled rollouts for new attendee experience capabilities, using feedback, analytics and event outcomes to validate value before scaling globally. Define governance, standards and guardrails for attendee-facing platforms, including branding, accessibility, localisation, content structure, communications, data capture, privacy, supplier readiness and platform configuration, to ensure a consistent global experience while allowing for appropriate regional variation. Measure and improve outcomes by defining KPIs such as registration conversion, attendance, engagement, session participation, attendee satisfaction, quality of experience, adoption quality and platform performance; analyse usage data, feedback and event insights to drive continuous improvement and demonstrate ROI. Lead supplier collaboration and integration alignment for attendee-facing technologies and connected systems, ensuring data flows, communications, reporting, accessibility services and downstream experiences work together to support reliable live-event delivery and a seamless end-user journey. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong product management fundamentals, including vision, discovery, prioritisation, roadmap development, backlog management, release planning and value measurement. Experience with attendee-facing event technology platforms, ideally including Cvent Registration, Attendee Hub, SpotMe or similar tools, and a strong understanding of registration, mobile apps, communications, engagement, translation, attendee tracking and onsite/digital event experiences. A strong understanding of user experience principles and the ability to translate attendee, planner and sponsor needs into clear product requirements, reusable standards, playbooks and measurable improvements. Integration and data literacy, with the ability to understand platform dependencies, attendee data flows, privacy considerations, reporting needs and how changes in one platform affect connected experiences, analytics and downstream marketing or sales processes. Ability to influence without authority across a global, matrixed organisation and drive alignment across regions, stakeholder groups, suppliers and delivery partners operating in a low-fault-tolerance live event environment. Excellent communication and enablement skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, create effective guidance and training materials, consult on best practice and support successful adoption of new attendee experience capabilities. Strong stakeholder, supplier and customer success skills, combined with analytical decision-making and the ability to use data, feedback, adoption patterns and event performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and value realisation. To qualify for the role, you must have Relevant experience in product management, product ownership, customer success, digital experience or technology-enabled services, preferably in a complex enterprise, events, SaaS or marketing technology environment. Ideally, you’ll also have Hands-on experience with the Cvent suite of products, SpotMe, or similar event experience platforms spanning in-person, virtual and hybrid delivery. What We Look For We’re looking for a collaborative, delivery-focused product manager who is comfortable operating in complexity, passionate about improving the attendee experience, and energised by driving adoption at scale. You build strong relationships, balance stakeholder demand with governance and compliance requirements, and use data to prioritise improvements that deliver measurable business outcomes, stronger event ROI and consistently high-quality experiences for EY attendees worldwide. What We Offer You The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $120,000 to $224,400. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $144,000 to $255,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis. For those living in California, please click here for additional information. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. description: Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe’s largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier. Now is a fantastic time to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years. Ryanair are currently recruiting for an AI Future Development Business Analyst to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years. The AI Future Development Business Analyst will support the ongoing development, optimisation and operational management of Ryanair’s GenAI chatbot and wider AI Customer Service initiatives.The GenAI chatbot is now a live, high-volume Customer Service channel operating across all markets and seven supported languages. It has generated close to 10 million customer answers and continues to handle large daily volumes of customer queries. Key Responsibilities Own and support the ongoing operational performance of the GenAI chatbot across all markets and supported languages. Act as the key link between Customer Service, CS Transformation, Labs, AWS and external vendors on chatbot and AI development. Validate chatbot outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency and alignment with Ryanair policies, customer journeys and operational processes. Support chatbot release testing, go-live validation and post-release monitoring across markets. Identify, investigate and escalate chatbot issues, including bugs, booking data/API retrieval failures, model inconsistencies and localisation errors. Analyse chatbot performance, customer contact drivers, repeat queries and customer journeys to identify optimisation opportunities. Experience working with chatbot, automation, digital customer service or transformation projects is desirable. Ability to analyse data, identify trends, monitor repeat contacts and recommend improvements. Strong understanding of customer journeys, operational processes and policy alignment. Ability to break down complex issues into clear, actionable steps. Experience gathering, documenting and validating business requirements. Strong testing, validation and issue-tracking skills. Ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with regular releases and changing priorities. Proficient in Microsoft Office. Familiarity with data analysis tools and techniques. Experience with project management methodologies is desirable. Competitive salary Discounted and unlimited travel to over 250 destinations Defined Contribution Pension Scheme Death in Service Benefit – Up to 2 times of annual basic salary 20 Days Annual Leave – Increasing to 22 days after 12 months and 25 days after 3 years of continuous service. Option for up to 5 additional unpaid leave days per year Cycle 2 Work Scheme Unrivalled career progression

description: Business Analyst | 36 uur Jij, als Business Analyst, brengt structuur in veranderingen. Wij geven je de ruimte om analyses om te zetten in verbeteringen. Als Business Analyst ondersteun je Geldmaat bij het analyseren, structureren en vertalen van businessbehoeften binnen de chartale keten. Je helpt Product Owners, programma’s en teams door processen inzichtelijk te maken, knelpunten te analyseren en requirements helder vast te leggen. Jij zorgt dat veranderingen goed worden begrepen voordat ze worden gebouwd of geïmplementeerd. Je werkt voornamelijk binnen change en optimalisatietrajecten en hebt geen uitvoerende rol in de dagelijkse IT of serviceoperatie. Je bent een inhoudelijke sparringpartner die helpt om verbeteringen zorgvuldig en beheerst door te voeren. Dit ga je doen In deze rol: Analyseer je endtoend business en ketenprocessen en breng je knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen in kaart. Vertaal je businessbehoeften naar heldere functionele en nietfunctionele requirements. Stel je user stories, use cases en functionele ontwerpen op. Modelleer je processen en ketenflows, bijvoorbeeld met BPMN. Faciliteer je workshops en interviews om input van stakeholders op te halen en te structureren. Ondersteun je verander en implementatietrajecten door impactanalyses uit te voeren en overdracht voor te bereiden. Werk je mee aan test en acceptatietrajecten door testscenario’s te helpen opstellen en acceptatiecriteria te beoordelen. Adviseer je Product Owners en teams over oplossingsrichtingen, scenario’s en risico’s. Ondersteun je procesverbeteringen door verbetermogelijkheden te signaleren en veranderingen te evalueren. Bewaak je de kwaliteit en eenduidigheid van documentatie en requirements. Stem je inhoudelijk af met business, IT, datateams en leveranciers. Waarom Geldmaat? This role is central to the successful alignment of operating models, data models, and system flows between a new Transfer Agency (TA) platform, Fenergo, and a multifunds system operated from Cafga. The platform adheres to high-availability principles (similar to Amazon's operational model) and must operate continuously without downtime. The ideal candidate will combine deep analytical skills with a strong technical acumen, particularly in systems integration, data modelling, and modern architecture frameworks. They will be a key influencer in shaping design decisions and ensuring robust, scalable integration. Understand and document current and target state operating models and data models. Work closely with engineering and architecture teams to ensure system integrity across all platforms. Conduct deep data model analysis and communicate conceptual models effectively to both business and technical stakeholders. Evaluate existing processes and challenge the status quo with evidence-based insights. Ensure alignment across three critical systems without impacting availability. Contribute to the design and implementation of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles where applicable. Collaborate with stakeholders to qualify the validity of design decisions and influence architectural direction. Required Skills & Experience: Proven experience as a Business Analyst in complex technical environments. Hands-on experience with Fenergo integration is essential. Strong understanding of data modeling, operating models, and systems integration. Solid exposure to Transfer Agency (TA) platforms and/or financial services technology. Ability to work in always-on environments with high operational demands. Strong conceptual and analytical thinking; able to translate complex data flows into actionable insights. Confidence to challenge assumptions and drive informed decision-making. Working knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles is highly desirable. Technical literacy and familiarity with modern architecture frameworks.
